name: B10-0216/2025 (ECR) – Targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – defending religious freedom and security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns attacks on Christians in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where armed groups have killed, abducted and displaced people because of their faith. It asks the Congolese government to protect churches and bring attackers to justice, and asks the European Union to put religious freedom at the centre of its policies. It also calls for safe zones, early warning systems and cooperation with the African Union. This is a statement of position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Christians in eastern Congo, the Congolese government, and European Union foreign policy.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission, the African Union and the Congolese government for follow-up.
